answer: At each reward pulse, agents with umber or ivory avatars present a chip-bound anonymous attestation. A certified secure element derives one nullifier per epoch from its non-exportable device secret; reject repeats, so 1,000 keys on one chip still get one reward slot. The issuer must certify each physical chip only once, not each software key. If a chip costs 60 units and earns at most 0.1/day, a farm needs 600 days just to repay hardware. This limits cheap cloning, not wealthy hardware farms, and excludes chipless agents.
